title: elsholtzia stachyodes
intro: Elsholtzia stachyodes, commonly known as Thai balm or wild basil, is a perennial plant native to Southeast Asia and India, belonging to the Lamiaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Elsholtzia stachyodes include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe skin irritations and boost the immune system. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as eucalyptol, linalool, and borneol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and aromatic fragrance.
